about: The one place each app's status and delivery time live. Edit here, run `node tools/status.mjs`, commit both. The deploy runs `node tools/status.mjs --check` and fails if a page disagrees. Status: live, beta or paused; the hero counts live and beta apps, never paused ones. Times come from each product's own send schedule.
